_comment: Social share cards for diginode.tools - drawn by build.py into website/share/<id>.png and set as each page's social image in Yoast. image.style: 'cutout' (transparent picture, the default), 'screenshot' (framed), or 'art' (art/<file>.html); no image = the DigiNode badge. Optional: eyebrow, text_width, title_size, logo_width.
